items.title: Repair Hermes learning attribution and profile concurrency
acceptance: Outcome reconciliation reads the append-only decision log rather than relying on consumable outbox packets.
Direct and learning Hermes invocations serialize access to shared profile state.
Worker failures preserve actionable child-process diagnostics.
Regression coverage proves durable decision discovery after outbox consumption.

items.title: Give the trading agent artificial session memory via a deterministic observation layer.
acceptance: The direct worker accumulates a rolling 1m bar ledger across cycles in exchange/hermes/supervisor/market-structure-state.json and derives regime (with hysteresis), range box, position/edge/breakout state, labeled swings, structure bias, unfilled FVG zones, key levels with touch counts, and the agent's own recent trade outcomes.
The observation block is injected into execution_scope as measured, provisional evidence (~400 tokens), is neutral when absent or warming up, and can never block a trading cycle on failure.
Session continuity does not depend on Hermes self-compaction: the model can be stateless per cycle and still see the session story (429/timeout resilience).

Deterministic unit tests cover swings, range/breakout, hysteresis, FVG detect/fill, ledger dedupe/prune, state round-trip, budget, and outcome-schema parsing; a replay over real decision packets produces a sane block.

Live validation: across at least one full session, decision audits cite location/structure when the block is present, and churn (repeat losses within the same zone within 45 minutes) measurably drops versus the v7 baseline.
evidence: 2026-07-31 v0.0.2.18: scripts/market_structure.py + worker wiring + observation_contract line; tests/test_market_structure.py 17 tests; full profile suite 22 passed.

Replay over 161 real packets from the 2026-07-31 session: 165-bar ledger, directional_up stable 21 cycles (ADX 36.9), price 0.98 of range testing_high, 3 unfilled bullish FVGs, own_recent_attempts shows the session's three losing trades; 1777 chars (~440 tokens).
Live-session validation pending: item stays open until the operator observes at least one session with the block active.
items.stop_line: Observations are measurements only: no action selection, sizing, stop, target, or veto may ever be computed here.

items.title: Equip cognition with a consultable market-structure playbook and anti-churn judgment principles.
acceptance: One consultable skill (glitch-market-structure) carries range/breakout participation, acceptance-vs-sweep, swing/BOS/CHoCH vocabulary, FVG and fib framing, ATR geometry comparison, pattern base rates labeled as unverified weak priors, and re-entry discipline; it is not loaded on the trading hot path.

glitch-trade-mnq gains a compact session-story section: location-first, acceptance-vs-sweep, respect own recent attempts, structure counts, noise-floor comparison — written as judgment principles, never gates.
SOUL grows by at most three bullets; the V7 non-overlapping instruction stack is preserved (no skill-count regression toward the pre-V7 eleven-skill sprawl).
The empowerment test holds: the agent can still return NOTHING with a good audit citing location.
evidence: 2026-07-31 v0.0.2.18: skills/glitch-market-structure/SKILL.md added (consultable); glitch-trade-mnq +1 section; SOUL +2 bullets; default cycle skill list unchanged (glitch-trade-mnq,glitch-build-intent).

2026-07-31 v0.0.2.18: added ruthless profit-taking doctrine (SOUL bullet + manage section), volatility noise calibration (10pts nothing / 20pts noise at ATR_1m~10, 40pt stop defended once to ~50 as example), and avg-in/avg-out staged tranche + scale-out ladder language in build exposure; glitch-learn now flags winners surrendered to stops/breakeven.
items.stop_line: No deterministic strategy, quota, archetype whitelist, or auto-geometry may enter any skill.
